description: A.D. Wimala Perera v. Harsha Kumara Hettiwatte and Others A.D. Wimala Perera v. Harsha Kumara Hettiwatte and Others View More before Hon. Anil Gooneratne, J.
parties: A.D. Wimala Perera v. Harsha Kumara Hettiwatte and Others A.D. Wimala Perera v. Harsha Kumara Hettiwatte and Others View More
keywords: The Appellant faced a preliminary objection that the appeal was defective for failing to name all the necessary parties under the partition decree and for failing to provide security for costs. Held - Such omissions were curable under Section 759(2) of the Civil Procedure Code; permitted amended petition subject to payment of costs. Preliminary objections overruled.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
